```{r setup, include=FALSE}
setwd("~/Desktop/524 project")
library(Biostrings)
library(msa)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

#### Read in DNA sequences
```{r, echo=F}
seqs <- DNAStringSet(c(
  Hap1 <- "", 
  Hap22 <- "", 
  Hap7 <- "", 
  Hap5 <- "", 
  Hap12 <- "", 
  Hap15 <- "",
  Hap16 <- "", 
  Hap18 <- "", 
  Hap13 <- "", 
  Hap20 <- "",
  Hap14 <- "", 
  Hap19 <- "", 
  Hap21 <- "", 
  Hap6 <- "", 
  Hap17 <- "", 
  Hap8 <- "", 
  Hap2 <- "", 
  Hap3 <- "", 
  Hap4 <- "", 
  Hap9 <- "", 
  Hap10 <- "", 
  Hap11 <- ""))
```

#### Align the sequences
```{r}
alignment <- msa(seqs, method = "ClustalW")

# Convert to a character matrix
aligned_strings <- as.character(msaConvert(alignment, type = "seqinr::alignment")$seq)
  
# Then split into individual characters
aligned_matrix <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(aligned_strings, split = ""))

colnames(aligned_matrix) <- 1:ncol(aligned_matrix)
rownames(aligned_matrix) <- names(seqs)
```

#### Find differences among these DNA sequences
```{r}
# Find polymorphic sites (i.e. locations where bases differ across sequences)
variable_sites <- which(apply(aligned_matrix, 2, function(col) length(unique(col)) > 1))

# Print the indices of the polymorphic sites and the corresponding bases for all sequences)
aligned_matrix[, variable_sites, drop = FALSE]
```
